info.title: Futarchy External API
info.description:
Public, read-only HTTP API serving Futarchy protocol DEX data (FutarchyAMM spot markets, plus Meteora pools for daily market data) to aggregators such as CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, DexScreener and Jupiter, and to dashboards.

**Versioning.** Every data endpoint is served under `/v1` (e.g. `/v1/api/tickers`) and, unchanged, at its unversioned path, which is a frozen alias of v1. Health, probe, metrics and docs endpoints are not versioned. Breaking changes ship as a new version prefix. A deprecated version answers with `Deprecation` (RFC 9745), `Sunset` (RFC 8594) and `Link: <…>; rel="successor-version"` headers.

**Units.** Token amounts, prices and volumes are in human units (already divided by the mint decimals). Most adapters serve them as decimal strings; fields suffixed `Raw` are integer strings in base units. Adapters whose consumer requires JSON numbers (CoinMarketCap, DexScreener, the Jupiter supply endpoints) serve numbers, as noted per schema.

**Rate limits.** Anonymous clients get 60 requests per minute per IP. Trusted partners send an `X-API-Key` header and get a higher limit; an unknown key is rejected with 401 `INVALID_API_KEY`. Rate-limited responses carry `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset` (seconds); a 429 also carries `Retry-After` (seconds). Container probes (`/health/startup`, `/health/ready`, `/health/live`) are not rate limited. Limits are enforced across all replicas when the deployment shares a Redis store.

**Caching.** Successful data responses are sent with `Cache-Control: private, max-age=30` (client-side reuse only; responses carry per-caller rate-limit headers). Errors, health and metrics responses are `Cache-Control: no-store`. Responses over 1 KB are compressed (`br`, `gzip` or `deflate`) when the request sends `Accept-Encoding`.

**Serving invariant.** Infrastructure failures (Solana RPC, served database) return a 5xx. The API never answers 200 with zero, empty, or placeholder financial data because a dependency failed. Retry on 5xx; treat a 200 as authoritative.

**Errors.** Every error is JSON in one shape, the `Error` schema: `{ error, code, field?, requestId }`. Branch on `code` (stable), not on the `error` message (human-readable, may change); `field` names the offending parameter on a 400. Each request may take each query parameter at most once: a repeated parameter is a 400 `INVALID_QUERY_PARAMETER`. Unknown routes return 404 `NOT_FOUND`. A request that exceeds the server timeout returns 503 `REQUEST_TIMEOUT`.

Unversioned alias of v1, kept for existing integrations

get.description: One ticker per FutarchyAMM spot market. Price, spread and liquidity come from live pool reserves; 24h volume, high and low come from the served ETL. A market with no trades in the last 24h reports volume "0" and omits high/low. Returns 503 `SERVED_DB_UNAVAILABLE` when the served database is not connected, and 503 `SERVED_DATA_STALE` when the newest FutarchyAMM spot swap is older than the server's freshness limit (default 6h), rather than reporting volume that drains to zero behind a stalled pipeline.

get.description: Daily FutarchyAMM (spot, conditional and total) and Meteora activity per token over an inclusive date range. Parameters are validated before the database is touched, so a bad request is always 400.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: First UTC day, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be a real calendar date on or before `endDate`.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Last UTC day, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). The range may span at most 366 days (server default); split longer histories into several requests.

parameters.name: tokens
parameters.description: Comma-separated base-token mints to filter by (at most 100, each a valid Solana address). Omit for all tokens.

get.description: FutarchyAMM spot swap events with `fromBlock <= slot <= toBlock`, ordered by slot then transaction. The range may span at most 500,000 slots (`toBlock - fromBlock <= 500000`); larger ranges, non-integer or negative bounds, and `toBlock < fromBlock` are 400.

parameters.name: toBlock
parameters.description: Last slot, inclusive. Must be >= fromBlock and at most fromBlock + 500000.

get.description: Process is up. Never checks dependencies. Rate limited (unlike the `/health/*` probes).
Served-database connectivity, data-contract and freshness checks. Returns 200 when `status` is "healthy" and 503 with the same body when it is "degraded".

503.description: Degraded (same body, `status: "degraded"` with a `message`), or `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` (`Error` body) if the checks took longer than the request timeout.

get.description: Container startup probe: 200 once the served database connected at boot. Not rate limited.
Container readiness probe: 200 while the served database answers within 2s. 503 with `status` "unavailable" when it does not, or "draining" during shutdown. Not rate limited.
Container liveness probe: 200 whenever the event loop can answer. No dependency checks. Not rate limited.

Prometheus text exposition format. When the server sets `METRICS_TOKEN`, requests must send `Authorization: Bearer <METRICS_TOKEN>` (401 otherwise); the endpoint is open only when `METRICS_TOKEN` is unset.

500.description: Metrics could not be generated (plain-text body).

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Optional partner key. Requests without it are served at the anonymous rate limit (60/min per IP); a valid key gets the trusted limit; an unknown key is rejected with 401 `INVALID_API_KEY`.

metricsBearer.description: Required on `/metrics` only when the server sets `METRICS_TOKEN`; the token is that value. When `METRICS_TOKEN` is unset, `/metrics` is open.

MintAddress.name: mintAddress
MintAddress.description: Token mint address. Invalid addresses are 400 `INVALID_MINT_ADDRESS`.

CacheControlNoStore.description: `no-store` on errors, health and metrics responses.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed per window for this client tier.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the current window resets.

XRequestId.description: Request id (echoes a safe client-supplied `X-Request-Id`, otherwise a generated UUID). Quote it when reporting problems.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request: `INVALID_MINT_ADDRESS` for a bad path address, `INVALID_QUERY_PARAMETER` for a missing, malformed or repeated query parameter. `field` names the parameter.

Unauthorized.description: Unknown `X-API-Key` (`INVALID_API_KEY`), or missing/invalid metrics bearer token on `/metrics`.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server or upstream (RPC/DB) failure. Retry later.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A dependency is unavailable or its data is stale (e.g. `SERVED_DB_UNAVAILABLE`, `SERVED_DATA_STALE`) or the request timed out (`REQUEST_TIMEOUT`). Retry later.

DexScreenerNotFound.description: No matching data (`NOT_FOUND`: "Pair not found" / "No blocks available").

Error.description: The error body of every endpoint.

error.description: Human-readable message. May change; branch on `code`.

field.description: On a 400: the request parameter that was rejected.

requestId.description: Request id, same as the `X-Request-Id` header.

CoinGeckoTicker.description: A FutarchyAMM spot market. All numeric values are decimal strings in human units.

last_price.description: Mid price (quote per base) from pool reserves. Decimal string in human units.

base_volume.description: Rolling 24h volume in the base token. Decimal string in human units.

target_volume.description: Rolling 24h volume in the quote token. Decimal string in human units.

liquidity_in_usd.description: Pool liquidity in USD. Decimal string in human units.

bid.description: Bid price. Decimal string in human units.

ask.description: Ask price. Decimal string in human units.

high_24h.description: Rolling 24h high. Omitted when there were no trades. Decimal string in human units.

low_24h.description: Rolling 24h low. Omitted when there were no trades. Decimal string in human units.

treasury_usdc_aum.description: DAO treasury USDC holdings. Decimal string in human units.

CoinMarketCapSummaryPair.description: One pair in `/cmc/summary`. Prices and volumes are JSON numbers in human units.

base_volume.description: Rolling 24h volume in the base token.

quote_volume.description: Rolling 24h volume in the quote token.

highest_price_24h.description: Omitted when there were no trades in 24h.

lowest_price_24h.description: Omitted when there were no trades in 24h.

price_change_percent_24h.description: Percent change vs the price 24h ago. Omitted for markets younger than 24h, or when the history source is unavailable.

base_name.description: Falls back to the first 8 characters of the mint.

name.description: Falls back to the first 8 characters of the mint.

maker_fee.description: Protocol fee rate as a fraction (e.g. 0.005).

symbol.description: Falls back to the first 8 characters of the mint.

DexScreenerSwapEvent.description: A swap. asset0 is the base token, asset1 the quote token. Buys carry `asset1In` + `asset0Out`; sells carry `asset0In` + `asset1Out`. Amounts are JSON numbers in human units.

txnIndex.description: Index of the transaction among this API's events in the slot.

eventIndex.description: Index of the event within the transaction.

reserves.description: Post-swap pool reserves (human units). Omitted if unknown.

SupplyAllocation.description: Non-circulating / liquidity breakdown for launchpad tokens. Amounts are decimal strings in human units; zero-amount entries are omitted.

InitialTokenAllocation.description: Claimed initial allocation that IS circulating (special cases).

DaoTreasuryTokens.description: Base tokens held in the DAO treasury vault (not circulating).

totalSupply.description: Total supply. Decimal string in human units.

circulatingSupply.description: Circulating supply. Decimal string in human units.

rawTotalSupply.description: Total supply in base units (integer string).

result.description: TOTAL supply (same as data.totalSupply). Decimal string in human units.
Supply. Decimal string in human units.
Circulating supply. Decimal string in human units.

allocation.description: Present only for launchpad tokens with allocation details.

totalCommitted.description: Total committed. Decimal string in human units.

totalCommittedRaw.description: Total committed in base units (integer string).

minimumRaise.description: Minimum raise. Decimal string in human units.

closeTime.description: Unix seconds when the launch closes.

tokenSymbol.description: Metaplex symbol; null if metadata is missing.

updatedAt.description: When the cached snapshot was taken.
